title: Alphabet Spell Turtle
description: A large surreal turtle stands in a desert landscape under a colorful aurora sky. Its massive shell is composed of dark blue segments displaying glowing letters of the alphabet, mathematical fractions, and paw prints, while its head emerges from the center wearing antlers and surrounded by a glowing circular pattern.
prompt: A giant surreal turtle standing in a desert at night with a vibrant aurora borealis in the sky. Its enormous shell is segmented with glowing white alphabet letters from A to Z, mathematical fractions like 9/12 and 3/4, and small paw prints. The turtle's head has antlers and emerges from a bright circular glowing pattern in the center of the shell. Red text at the bottom reads 'NO TINY PEOPLE WERE HARMED IN THE MAKING OF THIS VIDEO'. Cinematic fantasy style, detailed painting.
